title: Deeper Wilds
description: A resourcepack that bridges the gap between Deeper MC & Wilder Wild.
body:
# **Deeper Wild**

  A resourcepack that adds [Deeper MC](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/deeper-mc) support for [Wilder Wild](https://modrinth.com/mod/wilder-wild)'s unique mushroom blocks.

## **This resourcepack supports:**

### - Every type of shelf mushroom, with unique item textures:
Brown shelf mushroom, red shelf mushroom, crimson shelf mushroom and warped shelf mushroom.

![A showcase of brown shelf mushrooms in a Wilder Wild forest.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7449f1c337560fc8874a51eed6d539a2186d6f02.png)
![A showcase of red shelf mushrooms in a Wilder Wild birch forest.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/efffbe3ae0cc6ff9dad7e943adbdb4402b5019fc.png)
![A showcase of pale shelf mushrooms in a Wilder Wild pale garden.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/078a6acce4bff9573a8ba16c20d0ccbc0287c42d.png)
And others!

### - **Pale mushrooms.**

( Just like the original Deeper MC, pale mushrooms feature a random offset if [Polytone](https://modrinth.com/mod/polytone) is installed! )

![Pale mushrooms in a pale forest enhanced with Wilder Wild.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8157d885916e58c299d38f774b79aa55c8c8ae3.png)

[→ Gallery](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/deeper-wilds/gallery)
